recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Fix CausalGridWorld subgoal_mode waypoint-arrival detection (grid-cell-type coupling bug) + gate ambient self-contamination for hazard-free probes
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: causal_grid_world.py's waypoint-arrival branch (line ~2270) is keyed on target_type == ENTITY_TYPES['waypoint'], but the agent's own position marker (line ~2490, self.grid[new_x,new_y] = ENTITY_TYPES['agent']) permanently overwrites that cell the first time the agent transits it -- including a merely-passed-through, not-yet-current waypoint -- and the 'leaving a cell' logic reverts a vacated cell to EMPTY, never back to WAYPOINT. Fix: detect arrival by comparing agent position directly against self.waypoints[self._next_waypoint_idx] (the substrate's own completion_tolerance_enabled feature already does this correctly, gated off by default -- either flip that default for subgoal_mode or add a position-based check to the primary path). Separately, gate/disable contamination_spread for num_hazards=0 configs by default, or at minimum surface the V3-EXQ-513 precedent (contamination_spread=0.0) more prominently for hazard-free probe authors. Also add real episode-length + done-cause fields to the manifest (recording gap).

failure_record_entry.metric: Episode terminated at 32/19/90 of 400 configured steps (seeds 42/43/44) via agent_health<=0 self-contamination death, driven by a waypoint-arrival detection miss on the final waypoint of the sequence in 2/3 seeds (confirmed live-reproduced)
failure_record_entry.target: Episode should run its full configured N_STEPS budget (or terminate only via a scientifically meaningful condition), and every legitimate waypoint arrival should register a transition_type

learning_extracted: causal_grid_world.py's subgoal_mode waypoint-arrival detection depends on a mutable grid-cell entity type that the agent's own position marker permanently overwrites on premature transit through a not-yet-current waypoint -- a general substrate bug, not MECH-428-specific. Confirmed by live reproduction for all 3 seeds.

The ambient self-contamination mechanic (contamination_spread/threshold/contaminated_harm) is always-on and NOT gated by num_hazards=0 -- an established mitigation precedent exists (V3-EXQ-513/SD-049: contamination_spread=0.0) that was not applied here or in sibling V3-EXQ-883.

V3-EXQ-883 (MECH-427, sibling, PASS) escaped this defect only because its short, single-waypoint, single-attainment-event design never dwells long enough on any cell to trigger self-contamination or to require a multi-waypoint arrival that could collide.

Recording gap: the manifest's n_steps field is the configured budget, not the actual episode length, and done's cause (health-death vs step-cap) is not recorded -- this defect was invisible without live re-execution.

Scope risk flagged but NOT investigated (user-confirmed to route as a separate chip, not part of this autopsy): ~24 other experiment scripts (SD-034/MECH-268/ARC-071 commitment/closure family) use subgoal_mode with num_waypoints=2 or 4 and may carry the same latent defect in their confirmed results.
